Absent: Cells from an aged human brain with no neuritic amyloid plaques: cortical neuropil free of neuritic plaque burden, normal microglial and synaptic homeostasis.
Sparse: Cells from a human brain with sparse neuritic amyloid plaques: occasional focal plaques in neocortex with largely preserved neuronal integrity and minimal glial reaction.
Moderate: Cells from a human brain with moderate neuritic plaque burden: frequent amyloid-beta neuritic plaques across neocortex, activated microglia clustered around deposits, reactive astrocytes and synaptic stress.
Frequent: Cells from a human brain with dense neuritic amyloid plaque burden: abundant amyloid-beta plaques throughout cortical layers, pronounced neuroinflammation, gliosis and neuronal dystrophy.
nan: Cells from a human brain with uncharacterized neuropathology.
